title: Item:Slayer Count Boost
wikitext:
__NOTOC__{{Top}}
These potions increase the count you get toward [[slayer]] quests in adventure areas by a percentage.

The effect lasts for 1 hour. The timer pauses while in public area or logged out.

The slayer count boosts are bound to account. You can purchase them from the [[DDO Store]] or win them at [[Daily Dice]].
